notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.2 prints three CD formats: 'CD cd-name-1' FOR [INITIAL] INPUT with eleven optional clauses or a series of data-names, FOR OUTPUT with six clauses (DESTINATION TABLE OCCURS integer-1 TIMES [INDEXED BY]), and FOR [INITIAL] I-O with six clauses or a series. The grammar's communicationDescriptionEntry/cdMode/cdClause take the union (clauses in any order, §1985:XIV.2.2.3 SR3; INITIAL only before INPUT or I-O; clauses or a series, never both), and CommunicationSectionBinder#ReadClauses refuses by the CommunicationFormats table a clause of another format, a clause written twice, a series in an output CD and a series of the wrong length (COBOL6169); the facility is ungated at 85 per DESIGN-communication-facility.md section 1. Probes at --std 85 (class b each format's refusals and degenerate forms; class d FILLER in the series, a subscripted table item): Format 1 all clauses (Q=ABC MC=000000), INITIAL INPUT with clauses reordered, an 11-name series and a series with FILLER, and a clause-less CD followed by an 01 record all run; SYMBOLIC QUEUE Q1 SQ1 SQ2 (mixed) COBOL0001, a 3-name series, DESTINATION COUNT in an input CD, STATUS KEY twice, and a bare CD with no record each COBOL6169; Format 2 all clauses with OCCURS 3 INDEXED BY DX runs (SD2=D2 DC=0000), INITIAL OUTPUT COBOL5506, a series COBOL6169; Format 3 INITIAL I-O all clauses (ST=T1) and a 6-name series run, SYMBOLIC QUEUE in it COBOL6169, INITIAL after I-O COBOL5506. The witness's SYMBOLIC QUEUE in an output CD is refused COBOL6169. Classes c (no 2002+ phrase exists in the entry), e, f do not apply.
